defects.title: Since you were away shows a task as Completed while listing only the steps finished before the return
defects.repro: STANDIN_STEP_MS=800, token saved. Continue as Maya, send "long task: frozen [long]", close the page within 0.5 s, open the app again in the same browser 2.2 s later, then leave it open ~7 s until the task finishes.
defects.observed: On return: Since you were away "frozen | Running | Done: Collect... | Done: Compare... | Done: Check part 1 of frozen" while the task card already showed 4 of 8. After the task finished: Since you were away "frozen | Completed" still listing only those 3 steps, while Task: frozen reads Completed, 8 of 8 steps finished.
defects.expected: The report's status and its list of finished steps describe the same moment (either both as of the return, or both current), so it does not read as a completed task with 3 steps done.

defects.title: The "save a token first" alert stays on screen after a token is saved
defects.repro: Fresh DATA_DIR, no PROVIDER_TOKEN. Continue as Maya, type "hello before token" in Message, Send. Then type sk-local-abcdefghijkl in Provider token and Save token.
defects.observed: After Send: alert "Save a provider token in Setup to start chatting." (no message kept). After saving the token Setup disappears but that alert is still shown under the composer (observed 0.7 s after saving).
defects.expected: Once the token is saved, the stale instruction to save one is cleared (or replaced by confirmation).
